review_required.prefix-reuse vs prefix-caching: Related but not identical; reuse may include mechanisms beyond prefix cache.
review_required.remote-kv-cache vs distributed-kv-cache: Remote placement does not necessarily imply a distributed cache architecture.
review_required.llm-serving vs model-serving: Broad umbrella labels; keep only when they add retrieval value beyond layer.
review_required.heterogeneous-computing vs heterogeneous: Computing is broader than inference and should not be collapsed automatically.
review_required.paged-kv-cache vs kv-cache: Paged KV cache is a specific mechanism, not a synonym for KV cache.
review_required.distributed-inference vs distributed-ser: Distributed inference can refer to execution topology, not only serving control plane.

rules: Automatic aliases may be normalized without changing graph semantics.
Layer-like labels should move to canonical layer when they describe the primary system role; retain in areas only if they also carry useful technical meaning.
Review-required pairs must not be rewritten in bulk.
Area similarity never creates project-to-project or person-to-person relations.
